_comment: Dependencies whose license is not plainly permissive, read by a person
and accepted for this app. utils/dependency_licenses.py (CI and the
Claude Code hook) fails on any other such dependency. An entry covers
the license it names: a package that changes its license is asked about
again. Keys are package names as the ecosystem writes them (pip names
App-owned: an app adds its own entries; the template sync keeps them.
